metrics.note: Model/browser/http counters are zero by construction: this experiment is credential-free and synthetic. They were separately shown to fire on an injected event in PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY and are labelled injected, not observed.

AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP.expected_behavior: Every held-out in-support case across all six SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 families resolves EXECUTABLE with a non-null action bound at the expected field, executes against the fixture, and passes verify().
AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP.observed_behavior: 6/6 held-out cases (itm-0009, epsilon, tok-99, res-z, (tenant t9,item_id i9), n-09) resolved EXECUTABLE, 6/6 bound identifiers correct, 6/6 execution status 200 and verify True. in_support_executable_rate=1.0.

AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP.expected_behavior: Every declared out-of-support, missing-parameter and wrong-intent case is refused (non-EXECUTABLE, bound_action null, non-empty reason).
AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP.observed_behavior: 24/24 negative cases refused. out_of_support_refusal_rate=1.0 (15 empty/space/slash cases), missing_param_refusal_rate=1.0 (F5 missing tenant, missing item_id), wrong_intent_refusal_rate=1.0 (6 wrong-intent cases); F5 out-of-support pair also refused. All refusals carried bound_action null and a non-empty reason (EXPLORE for support/param violations, UNKNOWN for wrong intent).

AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST.expected_behavior: At least one fixture case has a bound-mechanism action != B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED comparator action, and the forced degenerate zero-contrast variant is detected as a certificate failure.
AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST.observed_behavior: 6/6 real cases have treatment action != comparator action (treatment_contrast_rate=1.0); the forced NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT variant yields contrast_rate=0.0 and is reported as degenerate_variant_detected=true (variant pass=false).

PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY.expected_behavior: On a seeded deterministic 5-step trajectory all eight counters match ground truth within max_relative_error <= 0.01; and on an inherited mechanism execution retrieval_calls, verification_calls and repair_attempts each increment by the expected non-zero amount; model counters fire only on an injected event and are labelled injected.
PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY.observed_behavior: max_relative_error=0.0 across all eight counters (model_calls=1, model_tokens=128, browser_actions=1, http_requests=1, retrieval_calls=2, verification_calls=2, repair_attempts=1, latency_ms=12.5). Inherited-path exercise observed increments retrieval_calls=3, verification_calls=2, repair_attempts=1 exactly matching declared. Model counters fired only on the explicitly labelled injected synthetic event.

AD-IDENTITY-BINDING.expected_behavior: The reconstructed fixture sha256 and the pre-repair and post-repair kernel blob identities are recorded and internally consistent, so the kernel under test is exactly identified in place of a direct code-hash freeze.
AD-IDENTITY-BINDING.observed_behavior: Fixture bank sha256=89a98e5de84a7f56dc8bdb966695db91aca6333743890be3bdc319df3e8c5427. Pre-repair kernel git blob sha1=cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50 (from the freeze commit). Post-repair kernel blob sha1=b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, file sha256=718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72. pre_post_differ=true and consistent.

B-LITERAL-KERNEL.expected_behavior: The pre-repair literal path (literal distill() confidence 0.5 vs resolve() min_confidence 0.8) produces zero EXECUTABLE resolutions on the held-out in-support set, so observed liveness is attributable to the in-scope repair and not the pre-existing literal path.
B-LITERAL-KERNEL.observed_behavior: 0/6 EXECUTABLE on the held-out in-support set (all UNKNOWN with no bound action); on the exact induction state the literal candidate exists but is EXPLORE at confidence 0.5. Causal attribution established.

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.expected_behavior: Deterministic K=5 structural field-overlap nearest-observation selector returns the literal action of the most similar induction observation as the non-gating comparator action per case.
B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.observed_behavior: Comparator action recorded per case; on all 6 families it differs from the bound-mechanism action (e.g. F1 comparator itm-0001 vs treatment itm-0009; F5 comparator t1/i1 vs treatment t9/i9). Non-gating as specified.

NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT.expected_behavior: Forced variant where treatment action is set equal to the comparator action on all cases; AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST must report zero contrast and FAIL the variant.
NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT.observed_behavior: Variant contrast_rate=0.0, n_nonzero=0, variant pass=false, degenerate_variant_detected=true. The certificate demonstrably fires on the retrieval-in-disguise degenerate treatment.

validity_notes: CLAIM CEILING: this packet provides ZERO evidence for or against the product thesis C-LLM-INHERIT. It measures only the shipped-kernel arm-differentiation certificate (liveness/selectivity/accounting/attribution). C-LLM-INHERIT stays HYPOTHESIS regardless of this outcome and must not be promoted on the basis of this packet.

FREEZE SUBSTITUTE (preregistered): the entire SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 fixture is specified in text inside prereg.md/spec.json, which freeze.json hashes; EXECUTE reconstructed it deterministically and recorded its sha256; the pre-repair and post-repair git blob identities of src/spider/kernel.py are recorded; and the behavioural checks cannot be satisfied without the required behaviour. This is the documented substitute for a direct code-hash freeze and is not a post-hoc weakening.

SELF-FULFILLING-CERTIFICATE THREAT acknowledged: EXECUTE authored both the kernel repair and the harness. Mitigations actually exercised: (1) AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP forbids an always-EXECUTABLE kernel and refused 24/24; (2) held-out identifiers are absent from induction observations; (3) the certificate is shown to fire on the degenerate retrieval-shaped treatment; (4) the fixture is text-frozen so AUDIT can rebuild it; (5) no pathological count occurred (EXECUTABLE rate on negatives is 0, refusal_rate=1.0); (6) the pre-repair literal path yields 0 EXECUTABLE, so liveness is attributable to the in-scope repair.

REPRESENTATION LOSS: the in-scope repair adds distill_parameterized plus a confidence-0.9 parameterized policy; the pre-existing literal distill() is deliberately left at confidence 0.5 so B-LITERAL-KERNEL remains reproducible. The default resolve() min_confidence is unchanged (0.8); parameterized mechanisms clear it, literal ones do not.

FIXTURE SUPPORT NARROWNESS: inferred support descriptors can be narrower than the fixture's declared grammar because they are derived from the finite induction values (e.g. F1 infers ^itm\-000[0-9]{1}$ from itm-0001..itm-0004). This is sufficient for the frozen checks (held-out values are accepted, declared out-of-support values rejected) but is a bounded-fixture artefact, not a claim of general grammar induction.

MODEL CREDENTIAL: no model credential was available or required. Model counters were exercised only via an injected synthetic event and are labelled as injected. The four-arm cold/instructions/retrieval/SPIDER benchmark remains unexecuted.

The orchestration wrapper files model_design.json (status success) and model_execute.json (status retry, attempt 3, exit_code 1, category transient) are infrastructure retry records, not experiment measurements; the measurements in this packet come from the deterministic certificate run, not from those wrapper records.
unresolved: The downstream four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark (A-SPIDER vs B-COLD, B-INSTRUCTIONS, B-RETRIEVAL) has not been run and cannot yield product evidence until a programmatic model endpoint credential is provisioned.

Generalization of the parameterized distillation path beyond the six synthetic families (real sites, richer action grammars, fresh/repair dynamics) is untested.
The support-inference narrowness noted in validity_notes should be re-examined before relying on it for real out-of-support rejection.
